label: kizuna_rival_a_02
text: Great timing! I’ve been having the hardest time\nlining up opponents to battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_a_03
text: But now I found you—in the schoolyard, no less!\nIt’d be silly NOT to battle! Whaddya say?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

text: I knew I could count on you![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_a_04b
text: Pfft, haha! You kidder, pretending like you’re not\nitching to battle! C’mon, let’s get down to it.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: kizuna_rival_a_06
text: Gotta step up my game so I’ll be ready anytime\nfor that Academy Ace Tournament![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
